items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Joe told me, well what are you going to do Butchie?

ctx.x: Then what happened is that night that all of us would be through here until I met him. Get that finish up. Yeah so Butchie.
After Butchie told me he didn't want me to say nothing to him and Joe told me, well what are you going to do Butchie? I'm not going to do anything. He said man, I'm a bad guy.

The same way, then the next thing about it, there was no dissension in the band. Everybody was happy. Just one big family. When they played the job, everybody was glad to play the job. They loved music, and they loved each other. They liked to play together. And they had one distinct style of putting over their music. They rehearsed the number.
